**Review of landing hero draft**

Checked against the brand policy:

- **"Good tea, guaranteed."** The policy doesn't include any product or satisfaction guarantee. The only allowed assurance is that subscribers can pause or cancel any time. This is an unbacked guarantee.
- **"Risk-free."** Also an unbacked guarantee. There's no returns, refund or money-back policy in the allowlist, so it implies protection we can't confirm.
- **"Certified organic by the Soil Association"**: on the allowlist. OK.
- **"packed by hand in Bristol"**: on the allowlist (every tin is packed by hand in Bristol). OK.
- **"free UK delivery on orders over £25"**: on the allowlist. OK.

No invented stats, superlatives, health claims, green claims, or urgency. The copy is short and not generic filler.

**Suggested fix:** Remove "Good tea, guaranteed. Risk-free." and replace with something backed, e.g. "Loose leaf tea and plastic-free tea bags, certified organic by the Soil Association, packed by hand in Bristol. Free UK delivery on orders over £25." Or, if a guarantee or refund policy really exists, have it confirmed and added to the brand policy first.
